items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: What is the mindset now going into the summer break? "I mean, just try and reset and find so…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问:暑假现在的心态是什么? "我的意思是,只要尝试重置 寻找一些速度是最大的事情。 但是在战略方面,你并没有计划一个被后方标记取出的战略. 所以我完全不能为此责怪球队. 试着在休息时间里改进一下,有一点时间重新设置,然后回来。”
items.summary: Q: What is the mindset now going into the summer break? "I mean, just try and reset and find some pace is the biggest thing. But on the strategy side, you don't plan a strategy for getting taken out by a back marker. So I can't blame the team at all for that. Just try and improve over the break, have a bit of time to reset and come back again."

items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: How are you feeling right now? "Obviously pretty disappointed. I feel like lap 1 was good. T…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问:你现在感觉如何? "显然相当失望。 我觉得第一圈不错 第一个标准是一般的,是合理的,我感觉到,然后努力争取步伐。 但即使这样,我还是觉得节奏不错 对不起 节奏不妙 但我有轨迹 我觉得虽然我挣扎,我可以坚持下去。 但从那时起,几乎所有可能出错的东西都做了".
items.summary: Q: How are you feeling right now? "Obviously pretty disappointed. I feel like lap 1 was good. The first stint is general was reasonable, I felt and then struggled for pace on the hard. But even with that, the pace was pretty good I felt like. Uh sorry. The pace was not good but I had track position. I felt like even though I was struggling, I could hang on. But from that point onwards, pretty much everything that could've gone wrong did."

items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: Were you disappointed to be pitted into traffic? Or was it the timing of the stop? "No I mea…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问:你是否失望地陷入交通困境? 还是停站的时机? "不,我的意思是我更生气 被卡洛斯撞倒。 我本来希望,也许,他们不会因为那起事件而陷害兰多 至少让我有机会继续领先 但我觉得这不太合理 我当时对所发生的事情感到非常不安。 我想我的坑站时间很好。 我们想击败刘易斯,这就是我们需要做的。"
items.summary: Q: Were you disappointed to be pitted into traffic? Or was it the timing of the stop? "No I mean I was more pissed off about being crashed into by Carlos. In the moment I was hoping, maybe, they would not pit Lando because of that incident to at least give me the chance to stay in the lead but I think that's not very reasonable. I was more very upset in the moment about what had happened. I think the timing of my pitstop was fine. We wanted to beat Lewis and that's what we needed to do to do that."

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问:我们开始你有多高兴? "哦,是的,那绝对是我的 种族的亮点,它走的相当下坡 从那里。 我是说很多事情要收拾 我首先想,硬轮胎的节奏只是无处可去。 然后被后背标记取出 从来没有真正的东西 你认为会出错 但我被证明是错误的。 显然变速箱 并非最轻松的日子
items.summary: Q: How pleased we're you with the start? "Uh yeah, that was definitely the highlight of my race and it went pretty downhill from there. I mean a lot of things to unpack. I think firstly, the pace on the hard tyres was just nowhere. And then getting taken out by a back marker never really something you think can go wrong but I was proven wrong. And then obviously the gearbox so um not the easiest of days."
